Generated by tools/figures/models_readme.py from the .sysml files, tools/sysml/check.py and the records. The records are the source of truth; the model is checked against them. Passing a check is not

g.text: Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · 3D = three-dimensional · CI = continuous integration (the automated checks GitHub runs on every change) ·
CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · M1, M2 … = mitigation in a hazard record (M1,
M2 …), or a SysML model check rule in tools/sysml · OMG = Object Management Group, publisher of SysML · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 ·
R01 … = validator rule in tools/pdac (R13 = only a named human review accepts anything) · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SysML = Systems
Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
